tldr: 台股上一交易日收紅356點至46,331點、成交量重返兆元關卡，台積電走揚至2,420元，帶量氣勢延續至本週。
台積電CoWoS先進封裝產能2026年全數售罄，月產能將自約7萬片擴至11.5萬片，AI封裝仍是盤面主軸。
金管會推進2026年八大金融新制，銀行財管2.0高資產規模達2.7兆元，私銀爭奪戰白熱化。
主計總處將2026年GDP成長預測上修至11.05%、創39年新高，AI帶動7月外銷訂單年增61.9%、美國訂單暴增近89%。
聯準會主席華許示警通膨，美股週五收低但週線收紅；中國8月官方製造業PMI今日公布，7月為49.2續呈萎縮。

items.title_zh: 台股站上46,331 量能重返兆元
items.title_en: TAIEX ends above 46,000 as turnover reclaims NT$1 trillion
items.summary_zh: 台股上一交易日開高走高，終場大漲356點、收在46,331點，漲幅0.77%，成交量10,230億元、為8月18日以來再度突破兆元。台積電上漲10元至2,420元續居盤面主導，AI晶片族群買氣延續；盤中在46,071至46,575點間震盪，反映法人承接力道穩定，為新一週交易打下多方基調。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark opened higher and ran up to close the prior session at 46,331, a gain of 356 points or 0.77%, with turnover back above NT$1 trillion (NT$1.023tn) for the first time since Aug 18. TSMC added NT$10 to NT$2,420, keeping the AI-chip complex in the driver's seat. Intraday the index ranged between 46,071 and 46,575, signalling steady institutional appetite heading into the new trading week.

items.title_zh: 評價壓力收斂 46,000點成多空關卡
items.title_en: Valuation compression eases pressure as 46,000 becomes the pivot
items.summary_zh: 法人指出台股預估本益比已由一個月前的20.71倍收斂至約18.86倍，評價壓力降低，但指數在46,000點附近仍須量價配合。券商建議核心AI供應鏈續抱，若量能放大可加碼散熱與光學族群，預估區間44,000至46,000點；指數要再上一階，仍需企業獲利全面上修支撐。
items.summary_en: Brokerages note the market's forward P/E has cooled to about 18.86x from 20.71x a month earlier, lowering valuation risk even as the index tests the 46,000 level. Strategists suggest holding core AI supply-chain names and adding thermal-management and optics plays if turnover expands, while flagging a 44,000–46,000 trading band; a decisive break higher still hinges on broad-based EPS upgrades.

items.title_zh: 台積電CoWoS產能2026全數售罄 AI需求遠超供給
items.title_en: TSMC's CoWoS capacity sold out for 2026 as AI demand outstrips supply
items.summary_zh: 台積電先進封裝CoWoS產能已售罄至2026年，月產能將自2025年底約7萬片擴增至2026年的11.5萬片。此一瓶頸凸顯高階AI封裝需求遠超供給，使先進封裝成為結構性獲利動能，並強化AI晶片供應鏈的議價能力，帶動設備、載板與封測族群後市想像空間。
items.summary_en: TSMC's advanced CoWoS packaging is fully booked through 2026, with monthly capacity set to climb from roughly 70,000 wafers at end-2025 toward 115,000 in 2026. The bottleneck underscores that demand for high-end AI packaging is running well ahead of supply, cementing advanced packaging as a structural profit driver and reinforcing the pricing power of the AI-chip value chain.

items.title_zh: 封裝藍圖加速 CoWoS-L與3DIC時程壓縮
items.title_en: Packaging roadmap accelerates as CoWoS-L and 3DIC timelines compress
items.summary_zh: 台積電封裝要角何軍表示，3DIC推進節奏由兩年縮短至約一年，重心並由CoWoS-S轉向CoWoS-L，同時示警載板端浮現供應鏈材料風險。升級週期加快擴大受惠面，涵蓋設備、ABF載板與封測廠；日月光投控可望因台積電外包毛利率較低製程而持續受惠，供應鏈題材延燒。
items.summary_en: TSMC packaging executive Ho Chun said the 3DIC roadmap is being pulled in from a two-year to a roughly one-year cadence, while the focus shifts from CoWoS-S toward CoWoS-L; he also flagged emerging supply-chain material risks in the substrate layer. The faster upgrade cycle broadens the beneficiary list across equipment, ABF substrate and OSAT vendors such as ASE, which gains from outsourced lower-margin steps.

items.title_zh: 金管會2026年八大金融新制分階段上路
items.title_en: FSC's eight major financial measures for 2026 roll out in phases
items.summary_zh: 金管會2026年八項新制持續推進，其中六項自元旦起施行，包括全體上市櫃公司須提前上傳股東會議事手冊及年報，並分三階段接軌IFRS永續揭露準則。此套措施強化公司治理與資訊揭露，同時推動上市櫃公司邁向更即時、標準化的永續資訊揭露，牽動企業合規與投資人資訊透明度。
items.summary_en: The FSC's slate of eight new rules for 2026 is progressing, with six taking effect from Jan 1, including a requirement for all listed companies to upload shareholder-meeting handbooks and annual reports earlier, and a three-stage adoption of IFRS sustainability-disclosure standards. The package tightens governance and disclosure while pushing listed firms toward more timely, standardised sustainability reporting.

items.title_zh: 金管會擬開放券商辦理外幣融資
items.title_en: FSC moves to let brokerages offer foreign-currency financing for overseas securities
items.summary_zh: 金管會推進開放證券商受託買賣外國有價證券得辦理外幣融資業務，擴大證券商業務範疇。此舉將提供投資人配置海外標的的更多槓桿選擇，並使券商拓展利息與手續費收入來源，屬深化台灣資本市場中介功能、提升競爭力的一環，後續實施細則與風控規範為市場關注焦點。
items.summary_en: The regulator is advancing a plan to allow securities firms handling clients' trades in foreign securities to provide foreign-currency financing, expanding the scope of brokerage business. The opening would give investors more leverage options for offshore holdings and let securities houses broaden fee-and-interest income, part of a broader push to deepen Taiwan's capital-market intermediation and competitiveness.

items.title_zh: 銀行財管2.0高資產規模衝上2.7兆元
items.title_en: Banks' "Wealth 2.0" high-net-worth business swells to NT$2.7 trillion
items.summary_zh: 台灣銀行端「財管2.0」高資產業務至5月底倍增至約2.7兆元、客戶數達2.5萬人，政策推動以來整體資產管理規模增加逾10兆元，達兩年預定增加4兆元目標的兩倍以上。公股與民營銀行皆重兵集結，聚焦私人銀行、家族辦公室及境外資產管理平台三大核心，競逐高資產客群「留財引資」商機。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's bank-run "Wealth 2.0" high-asset business has multiplied to about NT$2.7 trillion with some 25,000 clients as of end-May, and industry AUM has risen more than NT$10 trillion since the policy launched—over double the original NT$4 trillion two-year goal. State-owned and private banks alike are massing resources around private banking, family offices and offshore asset-management platforms to capture affluent clients.

items.title_zh: 永豐打造億級客戶「1+N」私銀團隊
items.title_en: SinoPac rolls out a "1+N" private-banking model for NT$100mn-plus clients
items.summary_zh: 永豐銀行升級版財管2.0方案鎖定可投資淨值與保險商品價值達新台幣1億元以上客戶，以專屬「1+N」團隊提供私人銀行服務、客製化結構型商品、家族信託與傳承規劃。此舉凸顯在超高資產客群競爭升溫下，銀行亟欲以高端客製化解決方案做出差異化，搶攻財富管理與資產傳承長線商機。
items.summary_en: SinoPac Bank's upgraded Wealth 2.0 service targets clients with investable net worth and insurance value above NT$100 million, pairing them with a dedicated "1+N" team to deliver private-banking service, customised structured products, family trusts and succession planning. The move underscores how banks are racing to differentiate through bespoke high-end solutions as competition for ultra-high-net-worth clients intensifies.

items.title_zh: CPI累積漲12.42% 2026遺贈稅級距上調
items.title_en: 2026 estate- and gift-tax brackets nudge higher as CPI passes the reset trigger
items.summary_zh: 財政部公告2026年遺產稅與贈與稅免稅額維持不變，但因消費者物價指數累積上漲12.42%、達到法定調整標準，各課稅級距金額同步調升。此調整使中高資產遺產的實質稅負略為減輕，對資產傳承與贈與時點規劃具實務影響，為高資產家庭年度稅務安排的關注重點之一。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's estate- and gift-tax exemption amounts stay unchanged for 2026, but a cumulative consumer-price rise of 12.42% has cleared the statutory threshold that triggers a bracket adjustment, lifting the monetary boundaries of each tax band. The change modestly eases the effective burden on middle- and higher-asset estates and matters for succession and gifting timing, a recurring planning point for high-net-worth families.

items.title_zh: 自住房地交易維持400萬免稅額
items.title_en: Self-use home sales keep the NT$4mn income exemption under the house-and-land tax
items.summary_zh: 依房地合一所得稅制，個人出售符合條件之自住房地，課稅所得400萬元以內免納所得稅，超過部分按10%最低稅率課徵。此優惠仍是家庭評估房產處分的重要考量，影響稅後實得金額與自住房地交易時點，在房市維持穩健之際，牽動民眾售屋決策與資產配置節奏。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's consolidated house-and-land income tax, individuals selling a qualifying owner-occupied property may exempt up to NT$4 million of taxable gain, with any excess taxed at a preferential 10% minimum rate. The relief remains a key consideration for households weighing property disposals, shaping after-tax proceeds and the timing of self-use home transactions in a firm housing market.
items.source_name: 財政部房地合一稅專區

items.title_zh: 主計總處上修2026 GDP至11.05% 創39年新高
items.title_en: DGBAS lifts Taiwan's 2026 GDP growth forecast to a 39-year high of 11.05%
items.summary_zh: 主計總處將2026年經濟成長率預測上修至11.05%，較5月預估增加1.41個百分點、為39年來最高；上半年成長14.15%、第2季實質GDP年增12.93%。AI帶動出口為最大動能，預估2026年商品出口達9,036億美元、年增41.19%，2027年估成長6.04%。數據亮眼但成長高度集中於出口，內外需動能落差為後續觀察重點。
items.summary_en: The statistics agency raised its 2026 economic-growth projection to 11.05%, up 1.41 points from its May estimate and the strongest pace in 39 years, after first-half growth reached 14.15% and Q2 real GDP rose 12.93%. AI-driven exports are the main engine, with 2026 merchandise exports seen at US$903.6 billion (+41.19%); 2027 growth is pencilled in at 6.04%, underscoring a powerful but export-concentrated expansion.

items.title_zh: 7月外銷訂單年增61.9% 美國訂單狂增88.9%
items.title_en: July export orders jump 61.9% as US demand surges nearly 89%
items.summary_zh: 台灣7月外銷訂單較上年同月增61.9%、優於預期，其中美國訂單暴增88.9%，成為最強引擎，反映AI與高效能運算需求熱絡。此創高動能鞏固AI供應鏈對台灣成長的主導地位；惟訂單高度集中，也使景氣對美國科技資本支出與庫存循環變化的敏感度同步升高，後市須留意需求可持續性。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's July export orders rose 61.9% from a year earlier, beating expectations, with orders from the United States soaring 88.9% to become the strongest driver amid booming AI and high-performance-computing demand. The record momentum reinforces the AI supply chain's grip on Taiwan's growth story, even as the concentration heightens sensitivity to any shift in US tech-capex and inventory cycles.

items.title_zh: 美股週五收黑但週線收紅 9月升息機率升溫
items.title_en: US indices slip Friday but log a winning week; Sept Fed-hike odds edge up
items.summary_zh: 據台灣財經媒體整理，美股最近交易日收低，道瓊跌92.02點（−0.20%）至45,544.88點、標普500跌41.60點（−0.64%）至6,460.26點、那斯達克跌249.61點（−1.15%）至21,455.55點，但三大指數全週仍收紅。聯準會維持利率不變、鷹派談話成焦點，報導指市場定價的9月行動機率升高，牽動台積電ADR與台股科技股評價。
items.summary_en: Taiwan-language market wraps noted Wall Street closed lower in the latest session—the Dow off 92.02 points (−0.20%) at 45,544.88, the S&P 500 down 41.60 (−0.64%) at 6,460.26 and the Nasdaq off 249.61 (−1.15%) at 21,455.55—yet all three still finished the week higher. With the Fed holding rates steady and hawkish rhetoric in focus, coverage flagged rising market-implied odds of a September rate move, a swing factor for TSMC's ADR and Taiwan tech.

items.title_zh: 中東與荷莫茲海峽情勢 牽動油價震盪
items.title_en: Oil stays choppy on Middle East and Strait of Hormuz headlines
items.summary_zh: 中文媒體追蹤原油走勢，市場在伊朗相關緊張與荷莫茲海峽外交訊號、以及供給改善前景之間拉鋸，使能源價格成為全球通膨與股市情緒的變數。地緣風險溢價與波灣出口回升相互抵銷，令油價維持震盪，並成為影響央行政策預期與風險偏好的重要跨市場變數，後續中東進展仍須密切觀察。
items.summary_en: Chinese-language coverage tracked crude's swings as traders weighed Iran-related tensions and diplomatic signals around the Strait of Hormuz against improving supply prospects, keeping energy a wildcard for global inflation and equity sentiment. The push-and-pull between geopolitical risk premia and recovering Gulf exports leaves oil an important cross-current for central-bank policy expectations and risk appetite.

items.title_zh: Fed主席華許示警通膨 標普週五收低但週線收紅（2026-08-28，最近交易日）
items.title_en: S&P 500 falls Friday after Fed's Warsh highlights inflation worries, but index posts positive week (2026-08-28)
items.summary_zh: 聯準會主席華許強調近期通膨改善未能確認基調實質好轉，壓抑降息預期，標普500指數週五收低。儘管最近交易日回檔，該指數全週仍收紅，反映投資人在通膨僵固訊號與企業獲利韌性、AI需求之間權衡；市場對聯準會9月路徑的分歧，成為後續美股與科技股波動的主要來源。
items.summary_en: The S&P 500 slipped on Friday after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh underscored that recent inflation improvement does not confirm a meaningful shift in underlying trends, tempering rate-cut hopes. Despite the pullback in the most recent session, the benchmark still finished the week higher, as investors balanced sticky-inflation signals against resilient corporate earnings and AI-driven demand.

items.title_zh: 中國8月官方製造業PMI今日公布 7月降至49.2（2026-08-31）
items.title_en: China's official August factory PMI due Monday after July slid to 49.2 (2026-08-31)
items.summary_zh: 中國國家統計局預定週一公布8月官方製造業PMI，7月數值為49.2、月減1.1個百分點，且連續第五個月低於景氣榮枯線50。若8月數據疲弱，將加深市場對區域最大經濟體製造業動能轉弱的疑慮，並可能壓抑亞洲原物料與出口連動類股情緒；此為當日亞洲時段的關鍵總經數據。
items.summary_en: China's National Bureau of Statistics is set to release its official manufacturing PMI for August on Monday, following July's reading of 49.2—down 1.1 points and a fifth straight month below the 50 line that separates expansion from contraction. A soft print would reinforce concerns about weak factory momentum in the region's largest economy and could weigh on commodity and export-linked sentiment across Asia.
